text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo. That rescue went rather well,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My magnificent beauty shined clearly
through the
glass, giving you the extra
boost you required!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh! No need to thank me! My
loveliness exists to
save the whole world,
after all!
